title: Intelligence Brief
subtitle: Moonshot's Kimi K3 officially launched as a 2.8T-p, Kimi K3's official pricing is $0.30 per 1M cache-h, BenchLM's independent post-launch read says K3 is

insights.text: Moonshot's Kimi K3 officially launched as a 2.8T-parameter MoE with 1,048,576-token context, native vision, max-reasoning-at-launch behavior, and full weights promised by July 27 — meaning the frontier-open story is real, but still API-first today.

Kimi K3's official pricing is $0.30 per 1M cache-hit input tokens, $3.00 cache-miss input, and $15.00 output — expensive enough to break the old 'open = cheap' reflex even before self-hosted weights land.

BenchLM's independent post-launch read says K3 is already #1 on LMArena's Frontend Code Arena, while Artificial Analysis measures 57.11 intelligence / 76.24 coding / 50.07 agentic and 62 output tok/s — enough third-party signal to treat the launch as substantive, not title-only hype.

LM Studio Bionic launched as a zero-data-retention agent app for open models with local Voxtral transcription, code projects, sandboxed document workflows, and model execution split across local runtime, LM Link, or Secure Cloud — the operator layer is productizing fast.

Open Interpreter already ships a Kimi K3 harness and documents browser QA via agent-browser plus native-app computer use via trycua, showing ecosystem alignment around K3 before the weights are even downloadable.

Nutlope/hallmark hit +3,372 GitHub stars/day with a portable anti-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex: 20 themes, 57 slop-test gates, and optional export of a reusable design.md. Skills are now packaging taste, not just tasks.

OpenCut surged to +3,537 GitHub stars/day while its rewrite promised a Rust core, headless mode, MCP server, and plugin-first architecture — the open-source video editor is being rebuilt as agent-addressable infrastructure, not merely a UI app.

Friday's browser/computer-use cluster points toward repairable supervision: Plover externalizes and edits task plans, Libretto fixes failing Playwright scripts in PR loops, and Cursor's still-unpatched zero-click git.exe RCE remains the live reminder for why computer-use agents need visible envelopes and guardrails.
